messages:
Emma: Quick heads-up: I'm doing a doc sweep to standardize SDK examples. Plan: rename client param `result` -> `response` in snippets, use `model_version` as the model identifier in examples, and shorten examples to one concise snippet per language + an expandable full example.

Devin: Sounds good. Do we also harmonize tone/length or only naming?

Emma: Both. Naming is the priority. Tone: concise, action-first sentences in captions. One-liner note near the snippet to remind that `response` is a client param, not the raw API payload.

Mike: Linter caught many code-fence issues (missing language tag) and some MDX playground failures for backticks. I'll paste logs into the PR comments.

Alina: Small terminology reminder: UI strings should use "model version" (two words). In JSON and SDK fields use `model_version`. Also prefer the term "prefetch" instead of "cache warming" in docs and examples. @docs-bot confirm?

docs-bot: Glossary policy v2: preferred term is "prefetch". Link-checker: 8 broken links under /docs/samples/ (see report in #eng-docs).

Sara: I'll port the Python snippet to JS and Go once PRs are up. Suggest unit tests for snippet where feasible and run link-checker locally before pushing.

Devin: Labeling: add `docs:migration`, `needs-glossary-review`, `needs-voice-approval` to each PR. Approvers: Alina (voice), Emma (author), plus one eng reviewer. Target review turnaround: 5 business days.

Mike: Note: don't rename API schema fields in docs unless API changes. I saw a suggestion to change `choices` -> `items` in an example; that's a no-go. Keep API names identical to contract.

Emma: Agreed. We'll only rename client-facing snippet params and state clearly in PR description: "Naming changes are examples-only; no API contract modifications."

Alina: I'll review for voice and glossary. If anything risky, I'll file a tiny RFC and note it in the PR.

Emma: Opening PRs now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4230 (py), /pull/4231 (js), /pull/4232 (go). Please review and drop quick comments. Target merge: EOD Fri.

Devin: ACK. Thanks team. :rocket:
